findings.desc: scripts/verify-orphan-surface.mjs:101-110 marks any `const x = createXHandlers(ctx);` as a directly registered factory. packages/main/src/registry.ts:196-200 has one legitimate const/manual-register case, but the detector does not verify that the const result is ever passed to registry.register/registry.registerBatch. In-memory probe of the detector regex on `const orphanHandlers = createOrphanHandlers(ctx); return registry;` produced {registered:[createOrphanHandlers], unregisteredFactories:[]}. That means the CHK-001/CHK-002 adversarial red case can go green for a future handler factory instantiated but never exposed, so the detector does not fully cover orphan handler recurrence.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 355899148 by changing the detector to count const-created handler factories as registered only when the const is consumed by registry.register/registerBatch/registerBatchMissing. Added runSelfTest coverage proving createOrphanHandlers instantiated but unregistered remains unregistered. Verified npm run test:orphan-surface, npm --prefix packages/main run test:orphan-surface, and npm --prefix packages/main run build all pass.
